name: Koi Suru Science
source:
Hiroshi Koizumi is a student at Oshima Private School. One day, he receives an invitation to the science club from a girl named Sakura Sakura. Hiroshi's shy but falls madly in love with Sakura at first sight and visits the club, which is located on the outskirts of the school property. However, as soon as Hiroshi opens the door to the club, he loses consciousness...

When he comes to, Hiroshi finds himself on an operating table. He sees a small girl holding an old book. She's trying to experiment on him! What's going to happen to him!? 

You will witness mysterious experiments, battles over the old book, and expectations of love in this love comedy.

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020614050903/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2002/k/koisuru_science/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
translation:
小泉弘就读于私立大岛学园。一天，他收到一名叫佐仓樱的女孩发来的科学社邀请。性格害羞的弘对樱一见钟情，疯狂地爱上了她，于是前往位于校园边缘的社团活动室。然而，他刚推开门便失去了意识…

醒来后，弘发现自己躺在手术台上，眼前有个手持古书的小女孩。她正打算拿他做实验！他究竟会遭遇什么！？

在这部恋爱喜剧中，你将目睹神秘实验、围绕古书展开的争夺战，以及对爱情的期待。

[编辑自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020614050903/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2002/k/koisuru_science/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
